messages:
Juno (Design): quick q for the group: thinking about collapsing the time-range picker into a micro control on latency cards. default: 1h, quick presets: 5m/15m/1h/6h, and an expandable modal for custom ranges. tradeoffs?
Priya (PM): +1 for compactness. ops folks like presets for quick triage. we should make the picker sticky per-dashboard so switching cards doesn't reset it. also want a visible indicator when sampling is enabled for the selected range.
Devon (Eng): compact picker is fine. implementation note: client should request metrics with explicit window param; avoid implicit server defaults. for expand we can lazy-load UTC-adjusted custom queries. perf caveat: many concurrent long-range queries (30d) can be heavy. recommend we disable exact runs by default for >24h ranges.
Ravi (Data): agreed. sampling behavior depends on window; for large windows we use heavier downsampling. API suggestion: `GET /metrics/latency?route=...&window=1h&bins=12&percentiles=95&approx=true` -> returns `p95_estimate`, `bins`, `sample_rate`, `confidence_ms`. client can show `~` and `sample_rate`.
Maya (Accessibility): accessibility points for a compact picker:
- ensure keyboard-only can open the expanded modal and select presets.
- each preset needs a clear aria-label like "5 minutes, last 5 minutes".
- if sampling is on for the selected window show an aria-live polite message: "Sampling enabled: values are approximate" when window changes.
Juno (Design): nice. microcopy thought for in-card UI: show time label "1h" and a tiny chevron; when sampling is active append `· ~10% sampled` in muted text. on hover/focus show a tooltip: "Showing last 1 hour. Sampling approximates results."
Priya (PM): copy for the sampling docs link in the modal: "Sampling trades query cost for speed. Run exact query for precise metrics (may take up to 30s)." Button in modal: "Run exact query". Confirm modal: "Exact queries may be slow and increase cost. Continue?"
Devon (Eng): exact-run should be an async job + poll endpoint. add rate limits per-org to prevent abuse. when exact-run is initiated for large windows, show an estimate: "This query may take 10-45s". store result in short cache (5m).
Ravi (Data): include `confidence_ms` in response so UI can render `p95 ≈ 230ms (±15ms)`. also provide a short natural-language histogram summary for SRs: e.g., `hist_summary`: "Most requests 10-50ms; tail to 700ms".
Maya (Accessibility): important: do not rely on tilde or icon alone. read out the confidence text after the metric. keyboard focus on the card should allow a text-only summary expansion for screen readers.
Juno (Design): UI behaviors to prototype: compact picker (inline), expanded modal w/ presets and custom range, sampling toggle with confirm, and a11y summary panel. also want a tiny badge `~` with aria-label "approximate values" instead of long text.
Priya (PM): also add telemetry: when users change range or run exact queries capture that event so we can tune defaults.
Devon (Eng): will add telemetry events and server guardrails. note: when user toggles sampling off, we should show a preflight estimate of query duration and cost.
deploy-bot: timepicker-sampling-preview deployed to staging at https://staging.redwood/team/dashboards
Juno (Design): I'll upload two prototypes (compact + expanded) and include keyboard flows & SR text templates by EOD. please flag any missing API fields in the next hour. :coffee:
